assumptions: The `.not` guard must stay intact: `expect(v).not.toBe(v)` can only ever FAIL, so a widened extractor must keep it excluded. Covered by a negative case.

The matcher search must start after the balanced close of `expect(...)`, so a call inside the actual side (`expect(x.toString()).toBe(y)`) is not mistaken for the matcher once the argument is no longer restricted to paren-free text.
Only VAC-001's JS/TS path is in scope. The pytest path (`pyTautology`) has no paren-based extractor and is unaffected.
